tagline.en_US: AnythingLLM is the easiest to use, all-in-one AI application that can do RAG, AI Agents, and much more with no code or infrastructure headaches.

description.en_US: AnythingLLM is an AI application that transforms documents and content into context for language models to reference during conversations. It allows users to connect various commercial or open-source LLMs and vector databases within a unified interface. Documents are organized into isolated workspaces to keep contexts separated, and the platform includes multi-user access controls and AI agent capabilities.
